name: Technitium DNS
description: Registers your devices in Technitium DNS Server (A and reverse records) and follows address changes, after a preview and your approval. Works with a primary and secondary server and with a Technitium cluster. It only changes records it created itself and never touches records made by anything else, such as Windows machines that register themselves. Tested on real Technitium 15.5.1 servers (primary and secondary).
author: Netlens
supports: Technitium DNS Server 15.5.1 with primary and secondary zones (tested on real servers)
Technitium DNS cluster (not yet tested on a real server)

releases.changelog: Handles CNAME records, so Netlens can give containers that share their host's address a name (add, replace and remove, checked on a real server). Needs Netlens 0.2.106 or newer.
Tested on real Technitium 15.5.1 servers. A PTR delete that finds nothing left (Technitium removes the PTR together with its A record) now counts as done.
First release. Written from the official API documentation and tested against a simulated Technitium server only: please try it on a scratch zone first and report back (see the README).
